title: FinalResponse v0.1
description: The Agent <-> external Evaluation Harness common wire contract (CLAUDE.md section 2). This is the exact object domain/runtime/agent-runtime.mjs's createSerializer() returns as `final_response` from runAgentFlow — never `execution_trace`, which is a separate sibling field, not part of this shape. A Harness must validate its input against this schema instead of hand-rolling its own field checks.

execution_mode.description: Must stay identical to domain/contracts.mjs's EXECUTION_ROUTES; enforced by tests/final-response-validator.test.mjs so the two can never silently drift apart.

jsonValue.description: Recursively restricts a value to exactly what the JSON wire can represent: null, boolean, finite number, string, an array of jsonValue, or an object whose every property value is itself a jsonValue. Excludes BigInt, function, Symbol, undefined, and non-finite numbers (NaN/Infinity/-Infinity) at every nesting depth, not just the immediate value — a schema-shaped container is not accepted just because its outer type matches.
